images.observations: English light dialog shows both selected rows with current and proposed status and unchanged discipline. Review checkbox and disabled Apply action remain visible in the scrollable dialog.
French dark dialog at 720 pixels shows both before/after groups, the unchecked review confirmation and disabled Apply button. Footer controls stay inside the viewport.
English saved-filter dialog explains that loading clears selection and preview, shows one of sixteen filters, and presents separate Apply, Delete, Import, Export and Close controls without overlap.
French dark saved-filter dialog fits the narrow viewport. The selected site-review filter, capacity, import rule and footer remain legible; background rows are deselected.
Light home has compact top bars, a categorized tool sidebar, restrained Open file action and grouped review, conversion and editing panels. Labels and icons are legible without overlapping controls.
Dark home shows clear group headings, readable muted descriptions and colored tool icons on restrained dark cards. Open file and top navigation remain distinct.
At 560 pixels the toolbar condenses to an icon search and the home tools flow into one column. Open file and all six visible review tools remain readable without horizontal clipping.
Dark reader places Measurements in the right panel with type, unit, precision and calibration controls. The white PDF stays distinct; bottom zoom is a single-line 54 percent control.
Light split reader shows two page-one views at 40 percent with equal-sized rendered pages, a blue active-view border and synchronization controls above. Bottom navigation remains readable.
English settings distinguish Classic and selected Liquid Glass cards, Light color mode, transparency option and automatic saving. All controls and Close button fit the modal.
French settings at 720 pixels show selected Liquid Glass, dark color mode and checked reduced-transparency option. Theme previews, explanatory text and Close button are legible within the dialog.
Linked source.pdf is active at page1/1 and67% zoom. The blue Native source document title, A-101 reference and blue rectangle are visible; the toolbar and bottom controls are legible.

Linked source.pdf is active again at page1/1 and67% zoom, with the blue source title, A-101 and rectangle in the earlier visible position. The green returned-to-source message is visible.
The blue source remains visible at page1/1 and67% zoom after return. The top toolbar contains Tools but no Return to source control; both source and destination tabs remain open.
The Plan links dialog visibly reports in red that the source PDF changed since preview and must be previewed again. The manifest path, target page2, A-101 metadata and action buttons remain readable.

The batch dialog shows two approved sources and two validated output paths with one approved link each. Source/page selectors and the fixed footer are readable. A small square-like separator appears between source filenames and output paths; it does not obscure their text.

Beta.pdf is selected on page1 and the visible blue preview title changes to Native source beta, with A-101 outlined. The source identity, preview controls and fixed footer remain readable.
With Beta.pdf as source and A-101 selected, Preview destination identifies Target.pdf page2. The red Native destination two title and rectangle appear in the preview; footer actions are visible.
Batch stopped after an error is prominent. The red existing-output refusal is readable and both linked output paths are listed as Not saved; saving is disabled in the fixed footer.

The completed batch retains both linked-copy paths and visibly reports export to native-save-receipt.json. The dialog is scrolled to this result while its fixed footer remains visible.
Target.pdf is active between the two linked-copy tabs, at page2/2 and139% zoom. The red Native destination two title and rectangle are visible and Return to source remains accessible.
The native batch dialog shows both Alpha and Beta outputs, each with one approved link. The explicit preview controls and Save reviewed copies button are visible within the window.
Alpha.pdf is selected on the preview row. The displayed source is Alpha page 1, with the blue Native source alpha title and A-101 reference; the dialog footer remains visible.

Beta.pdf is selected on the same preview row. The displayed source switches to Beta page 1 with the blue Native source beta title and A-101 reference, while the approved output counts remain one each.

The selected source is Beta.pdf and the selected destination is A-101. The destination caption identifies Target.pdf page 2, and the preview shows the red Native destination two title and red drawing.
The batch visibly stops with an existing-output error. Both Alpha-linked.pdf and Beta-linked.pdf are explicitly listed as not saved; the review controls remain available.
Batch completed is visible with two distinct new linked-copy paths for Alpha and Beta. Export save receipt is available and the last input identity check is shown.
The completed batch retains both linked-copy paths and explicitly confirms export to native-save-receipt.json. The success message is readable above the fixed dialog footer.
After opening the saved Beta link, Target.pdf is active at page 2 of 2 with the red Native destination two title and drawing. The Beta-linked.pdf tab and Return to source control are visible.
The linked source document is active at page 1 of 1 and 67 percent zoom. Its blue source title, A-101 reference and rectangular drawing are visible at a stable reading location.
Navigation opens Native destination.pdf at physical page 2 of 2 and 139 percent zoom, showing the red Native destination two title and drawing. Return to source is visible.

limits: Only listed images were directly inspected or match a previously inspected image pixel for pixel.
Synthetic revision-transfer CLI batch qualification does not prove native desktop revision queue creation, review or saving.
Synthetic rectangle qualification does not prove native pointer interaction or physical survey accuracy.
Overlay pixel qualification proves the listed synthetic exports, not native desktop stack interaction.
Saved-stamp qualification covers explicit synthetic CLI capture and reuse; native desktop interaction was not exercised.
Overlay setup qualification covers synthetic CLI save/reopen and relocation; native desktop setup interaction was not exercised.
No physical-device, native operating-system backdrop or whole-roadmap completion claim.

conformance.scope: Machine validation of the specified profiles and first-page appearance; human PDF/UA semantics remain unqualified.

revision_batch.scope: Synthetic CLI batch creation and independent saved-output checks; no desktop interaction or private-plan claim.

rotated_rectangles.scope: Synthetic packaged CLI and QPDF geometry, not native pointer or physical survey qualification.

overlay_stack.scope: Synthetic packaged CLI overlay exports and independent interior-pixel checks; no native desktop interaction or private-plan claim.

saved_stamps.scope: Synthetic packaged CLI capture/reuse and independently decoded PDF appearance resources; no native desktop interaction claim.

overlay_setups.scope: Original synthetic local PDFs, packaged CLI setup save/reopen/relocation, source bindings, refusal behavior and independent RGBA checks. No native desktop interaction or private-plan qualification is claimed.

formula_unit_conversion.scope: Original synthetic PDF, packaged CLI quantity formula conversion, JSON/CSV values, issue report PDF text and formula-free workbook cells. No native desktop interaction, external spreadsheet recalculation or private-plan accuracy is claimed.

register_field_batch.scope: Original synthetic two-page PDF; explicit cross-page field selection, saved PDF content and appearance preservation, refusal guards and AES-256 permissions. No native desktop interaction, Undo/Redo, signature validity or external-reader rendering is claimed.

saved_text.scope: Original synthetic PDFs and 12 standard font variants on four rotated cropped pages; packaged CLI capture and reuse, independently decoded PDF objects and exact rendered RGBA. No native desktop interaction, external-reader rendering, arbitrary fonts or PDF/A claim.

dimensioned_ellipses.scope: Original synthetic cropped PDFs, packaged CLI and independent QPDF decoding. Eight saved 128-segment polygons, their actual appearance paths and reopened quantities. No analytic ellipse area substitution, native desktop, external reader, physical survey or PDF/A qualification.

dimensioned_segments.scope: Original synthetic cropped PDFs, packaged CLI and independent QPDF decoding. Nine saved two-point lengths, their actual open appearance paths and reopened quantities. No persistent geometric constraints, native desktop, external reader, physical survey or PDF/A qualification.

limitations: Register-field batch corpus verifies explicit CLI selections and actual saved objects; native interaction is not established by this corpus. Encrypted objects are checked from retained QPDF transcripts; private ephemeral passwords are not retained for a second decryption.
Formula conversions use independent decimal oracles and actual JSON/CSV/PDF/workbook artifacts; native formula entry and spreadsheet recalculation were not exercised.
Overlay setup qualification covers synthetic packaged CLI save, reopen, relocation and source-bound refusals; native desktop setup interaction was not exercised.
Saved-stamp capture covers the original synthetic mixed group, actual decoded PDF appearances and every embedded PNG pixel; native desktop capture was not exercised.

Overlay-stack qualification covers original synthetic CLI exports, exact decoded legacy pixels and analytic interior-pixel checks; native desktop layer interaction and private-plan accuracy were not exercised.
Rotated rectangle qualification uses synthetic packaged CLI output and independent QPDF metadata/appearance geometry; native pointer interaction and physical survey accuracy were not exercised.
Revision batch publication uses synthetic packaged CLI and independent QPDF checks; native desktop queue creation, review and saving were not exercised.
The legacy navigation corpus uses CLI-prepared links. A separate Ubuntu X11 corpus creates, reviews, saves and reopens two synthetic linked PDFs; dirty-target-tab interaction was not exercised.
Native return-to-source qualification covers one return to the observed source position; restoring both split panes and repeated returns were not exercised.
Home qualification covers visible headings, the compact Open file row and their accessible actual text pixels; lower scroll content is outside those frames.
Native theme captures verify neutral Glass chrome and saved reduced-effects settings. Flat docked chrome does not prove a visual difference between effects modes.
Split reading opens two locations in the same PDF; different-document split reading is not included.
Windows reader screenshots use offscreen DX12 software rendering. Native split-view interaction was exercised on the recorded Ubuntu X11 environments, not on physical Windows or Mac hardware.
Mac OCR, printing, certificate signing, protected Office import, persistent encrypted visual-signature storage and automatic update installation are unavailable.
Windows packages unsigned; macOS ad hoc signed, not notarized; independent update signing unavailable.
Windows ARM64 cross-built without native ARM64 execution. No physical GPU, Wayland, printer or human accessibility qualification.
No whole-roadmap, universal interoperability, private project-plan accuracy or general PDF/A/PDF/UA conformance claim.
